description: This is a Java source file defining the VariantEvents class, which handles product variant related events in the Apache OFBiz framework. The main method implements the logic to create variant products based on selected features, managing database transactions and entity updates.

classes.name: VariantEvents
classes.description: Class that handles events related to product variants, specifically including the creation of variant products from a virtual product and selected features.

methods.name: quickAddChosenVariant
methods.description: Handles the HTTP request to create a product variant based on selected features. It validates input parameters, manages database transactions to create or update product entities, adds associations, and feature applications, then commits the transaction or rolls back upon error, returning a success or error status.
